scientific_integrity: The rational equivariant Euler identity is derived from unique star/top facet containment and independently corroborated in four finite parameter cases; exact nonstandard claims and infinite quantifiers are proved in RESULT.md. Computations are finite checks, not proof of infinite range. First public date is the supporting graph-power source, not a claimed date of discovery.
scientific_limitations: Only scale-one Johnson graph clique complexes with n>=6 and 3<=k<=n-3; rational module and rational orbit-homology, not integral lattices, other scales, contractibility, or positive Specht decomposition. Weight-three case is covered by earlier work. Independent proof and priority verification not performed.
title: All-weight symmetric-group homology characters of Johnson graph clique complexes
